# chameleon_contract_quality (Data Source)

Fetch the latest data quality run result for a contract.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "chameleon_contract_quality" "orders_latest" {
  contract_id = "5f7c8b53-1f1e-4f8b-92dc-9c3d7c8a4d20"
}

output "orders_dq_status" {
  value = data.chameleon_contract_quality.orders_latest.status
}

output "orders_dq_score" {
  value = data.chameleon_contract_quality.orders_latest.score
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `contract_id` (String)

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
